info.title: CrustAPI
info.description: People Refresh, public LinkedIn profiles, companies, posts, jobs and people search, plus Google Maps and Search. LinkedIn data uses public, logged-out sources. Returned fields vary by record. Wallet accounts use prepaid USD funds at each deposit’s saved endpoint rates. Eligible accounts receive $6 of free usage monthly; paid funds never expire. Empty and failed results are uncharged. Use explicit USD billing fields for accounting. See https://crustapi.com/docs and https://crustapi.com/pricing.

get.summary: Refresh a person or retrieve public LinkedIn data
get.description: Set type=refresh and provide a LinkedIn profile URL for current public details at the response root. Person/profile returns a profile object; company a company object; posts and people/search arrays; a job URL returns one record under jobs while job searches return an array. Field availability varies. Each successful operation uses its endpoint rate; enriched People is billed per full profile and Refresh per accessible profile. Empty and failed results are uncharged. Missing values or URL status do not prove a job change or permanent deletion.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: What to fetch. Singular gets the one you point at, plural finds many: person (one profile by URL) / people (find people by keywords) / company / job (one job by URL) / jobs (find jobs by keywords) / posts / refresh (fast freshness check). `profile` and `search` are the previous names for person and people and keep working unchanged.

post.summary: Process a list of LinkedIn URLs
post.description: Up to 100 URLs synchronously, or 10,000 with a public HTTPS webhook. Supported types: refresh, person/profile, company, posts. Results remain in input order. Each row carries its own data or error and successful rows use the chosen endpoint rate. Large webhook payloads may be replaced by a temporary resultsUrl; download before resultsExpireAt. Status requests return counts and delivery state, not result rows. Webhooks cannot contain embedded credentials; redirects are not followed and failed delivery is retried once.

urls.description: URL list. Maximum 100 without webhook; maximum 10,000 with webhook. Use the URL type required by the operation.

webhook.description: Public HTTPS URL for asynchronous delivery. Required for more than 100 URLs.

charged.description: Successful billing-unit count. Use billing.chargedUsd for the USD charge.

creditsRemaining.description: Numeric compatibility count of remaining affordable billing units for wallet accounts; legacy accounts return remaining credits. This is not a dollar amount. Use billing.remainingUsd or wallet.availableUsd for USD accounting.

data.description: Operation payload without the single-request timing/billing envelope. Refresh is a flat object; person/company are objects; posts is an array. May be null for unavailable data.

notAccessible.description: Present when the row represents unavailable data; uncharged.

202.description: Accepted for asynchronous processing and webhook delivery.

400.description: Invalid body, unsupported type, invalid webhook, or more than 100 sync / 10,000 async URLs.

402.description: Insufficient available balance or legacy credits. No successful result is charged when the operation cannot be funded.

429.description: Rate limited; retry according to response headers.

get.description: One endpoint for the whole Google menu. Set `type` to choose the surface (default `web`). Each type returns a JSON response under its own key: web/scholar/patents/lens -> `organic`; news -> `news`; shopping -> `shopping`; images -> `images`; videos -> `videos`; maps/places -> `places`; reviews -> `reviews`; autocomplete -> `suggestions`; webpage -> `text` + `metadata` + `jsonld`. Google surfaces are billed per successful request at the Google Search rate, except type=maps, which bills per business returned at the Maps rate. Wallet prices depend on the available funds and their saved rates. Failed and empty results are free. Legacy credit accounts retain their existing billing model.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Which Google surface to query.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The search query. Required for every type EXCEPT webpage and lens (use `url`) and reviews (use `placeId` / `cid` / `fid`).

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: type=webpage: the page URL to scrape. type=lens: the image URL for reverse image search.

parameters.name: gl
parameters.description: Country code (us, gb, de, ...). Not used by maps, patents, or webpage.

parameters.name: hl
parameters.description: Language code (en, es, ...). Not used by patents or webpage.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Result page. Not used by reviews, autocomplete, webpage, or lens.

parameters.name: tbs
parameters.description: Time filter for web/news/images/videos (e.g. qdr:h past hour, qdr:d past day, qdr:w past week, qdr:m past month, qdr:y past year).

parameters.name: num
parameters.description: type=reviews: reviews per page (default 20, max 50).

parameters.name: ll
parameters.description: type=maps: GPS position and zoom as @latitude,longitude,zoom.

parameters.name: placeId
parameters.description: Google place id (ChIJ...). Optional for maps; identifies the place for reviews.

parameters.name: cid
parameters.description: Google customer id. Optional for maps; identifies the place for reviews.

parameters.name: fid
parameters.description: Google feature id (0x..:0x..). Identifies the place for reviews.

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: type=reviews: review sort order.

parameters.name: nextPageToken
parameters.description: type=reviews: cursor from the previous response to fetch the next page of reviews.

parameters.name: includeMarkdown
parameters.description: type=webpage: also return the page rendered as Markdown.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: City/region hint for web and places.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: type=maps only: how many businesses to return (1-100). Each returned business is one Maps billing unit.

parameters.name: stars
parameters.description: Maps: request available 1–5-star review counts in reviewsDistribution. Can increase response time. Alias: details=true.

parameters.name: fresh
parameters.description: Set fresh=1 to request a new Google result. Reused identical searches are marked cached and cacheAgeSeconds.

parameters.name: details
parameters.description: Alias for stars=true on Maps. Requests available 1–5-star review counts and can increase response time.
